input: every generate dispatch returns zero candidates
expect: Run returns an honest empty-candidates result with a plain-language digest saying no candidates were found, not a fabricated candidate or a crash; expected/returned/missingLabels still populate.

Tool-radar dispatch count clamps to 3 regardless of the requested value; the plan still contributes exactly 3 mining jobs and the fixed prompt-snippet audit adds exactly 1 more job to that mining wave; digest survivor count clamps to 10 regardless of filter output size.

input: inspect what the Filter node's prompt contains
expect: The filter agent's prompt contains only the raw candidate list (name/category/rationale/evidence/source) — never the plan node's reasoning, never a generating dispatch's own transcript, never the caller's conversation. Verifier context-isolation holds by construction.

input: one of the 7 generate jobs (3 planned mining + the fixed prompt-snippet audit + 3 tool-radar) never returns
expect: generateMissing names that job's label; the final report's missingLabels field carries it through; the digest is still produced from whatever did return, never silently treated as complete.

input: inspect dispatch routing for a mining vs a tool-radar dispatch
expect: Mining dispatches (skill-evidence-sweep, agent-candidate-scan) run on the default session model (no agentType override) after two real 2026-08-28 live runs both aborted agentType Explore mid-task against Pi's session-transcript directory; tool-radar dispatches still route to agentType web-research-summarizer. Mining is never routed to web-research-summarizer, the wrong tool for a codebase-mining source.

input: inspect the mining dispatch objectives the plan node is instructed to write
expect: The plan-node prompt explicitly instructs the mining dispatch objectives to follow skills/ai-author/SKILL.md's bounded session evidence sweep procedure by reference (read the file, follow its numbered steps), never duplicating that procedure's text inline.

input: digest has zero agent-category survivors but nonzero skill and tool survivors
expect: The digest-writing prompt instructs omitting the '## Agents worth authoring' heading entirely rather than emitting an empty section under it.

input: inspect the mining dispatch's reading-boundedness instruction text
expect: The instruction explicitly tells the mining agent that repetition evidence is not limited to artifact usage logs, and to grep session transcripts for a friction marker (recurring warning, repeated workaround, silently-failed operation) that appears 2+ times as measured (not estimated) evidence, with zero candidates still a valid honest result when nothing repeats.

input: inspect the sequencing between mining and tool-radar dispatches
expect: Tool-radar dispatches wait for all 4 mining jobs (the 3 plan-created jobs plus the fixed prompt-snippet audit) to complete first, then run in their own parallel wave; tool-radar is never dispatched before mining resolves, and no mining job is sequenced outside that one parallel wave.

input: inspect what a tool-radar dispatch actually receives as its prompt
expect: Each tool-radar dispatch prompt includes a grounding block built from mining's real candidate evidence (or an explicit zero-friction variant when mining found nothing) and a hard requirement that its rationale name the specific friction item addressed or explicitly ground fit in this repo's real stack, never a static grounding note the plan node wrote before mining ran.

input: inspect the fixed prompt-snippet audit's graph integration
expect: Exactly one fixed job labeled prompt-snippet-audit runs beside all 3 plan-created mining jobs in the same parallel wave. The workflow renames any plan-created label that collides with the fixed label. Its candidates enter the same raw candidate collection and fresh-context Filter as every other generator. Its label is included in expected, returned, and missingLabels accounting, including when that audit alone fails to return.

input: inspect the prompt-snippet audit's source, bounds, classification, and output rules
expect: The audit checks the current files under pi/extensions/prompt-snippets/snippets/, reads no more than 500 direct-use records from the latest 30 days at $PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/prompt-snippets-usage.jsonl or ~/.pi/agent/prompt-snippets-usage.jsonl, and uses grep-first bounded reads across no more than 200 parent-session transcripts active in the latest 30 days for equivalent manually typed user requests. It keeps direct uses and equivalent manual requests as distinct evidence classes. Its output uses the aggregate source label, never a source path, and never includes prompt text, response text, raw records, transcript excerpts, session identifiers, or session paths.

input: the prompt-snippet audit finds sparse, missing, or ambiguous evidence
expect: Absence is unknown, never evidence to remove a snippet. An add requires repeated evidence from at least 2 parent sessions. A merge or removal requires measured co-use, conflict, or overlap with an existing skill. If those thresholds are not met, the audit returns zero candidates.
